title: Canonical etale compact-support, horizontal composition and base-change comparisons
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring of universe $u+1$. Work with schemes of universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme] which are Noetherian (finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]), and ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $F_a=Ra_!$ for compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support], using the chosen compactifications [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and $S_a=D(a_{\Sigma!})$ for etale sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. Fix a graph-normalized compact-support comparison datum $N$ [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization].

(1) For a separated quasi-compact etale map $a:U\to V$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] with a compactification, let $c_a$ be its chosen compactification. Define $d_a:F_a\xrightarrow{\sim}S_a$ to be the inverse of the canonical isomorphism $F_a^{c_a}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_a$, followed by $N$'s comparison $F_a^{c_a}\xrightarrow{\sim}S_a$.

(2) In a Cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $v:Y'\to Y$, and $v':X'\to X$, assume all four arrows are quasi-compact, that $v,v'$ are separated etale, and give all four arrows and both equal composites $f\circ v'=v\circ f'$ compactifications. Use the specified composition isomorphisms $\alpha_{b,a}:F_bF_a\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{b\circ a}$ of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Define
$$\delta=(d_vF_{f'})\circ\alpha_{v,f'}^{-1}\circ\alpha_{f,v'}\circ F_f(d_{v'}^{-1}):F_fS_{v'}\xrightarrow{\sim}S_vF_{f'},$$
where the middle composite includes the canonical congruence isomorphism for the square's equality $f\circ v'=v\circ f'$.

(3) For a Cartesian square with the same arrow names, without requiring $v,v'$ etale, suppose $f$ is separated of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], $f'$ is quasi-compact, and $f,f'$ have compactifications. Regard the specified unbounded compact-support exchange of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] as the natural isomorphism
$$C_{f,v}:v^*F_f\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{f'}v'^*,$$
where inverse image is the exact degreewise inverse image on the constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Its forward map is exactly that recorded exchange; its inverse is the inverse of that map. These are definitions of the three canonical comparisons only; the horizontal-support-mate counit identity is not an ingredient.

def etaleHorizontalSupportMateDelta
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {v : Y' ⟶ Y} {v' : X' ⟶ X}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X'] [CompactSpace X']
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y'] [CompactSpace Y']
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification f']
    [Etale v] [Etale v'] [IsSeparated v] [IsSeparated v']
    [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v']
    [HasCompactification v] [HasCompactification v']
    [HasCompactification (v' ≫ f)] [HasCompactification (f' ≫ v)]
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact f'] [QuasiCompact v] [QuasiCompact v']
    [QuasiCompact (v' ≫ f)] [QuasiCompact (f' ≫ v)]
    (sq : IsPullback v' f' f v)
    (N : EtaleCompactSupportNormalization A) :
    (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v' inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ≅
      rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f' ⋙
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory
